developerWorkflow: Read AGENTS.md, then handoff/README.md, PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md and the paired human/machine briefs
Run npm test before changes; keep the selection model, the three row scopes, the focus modes and the panel action contract
Change one bounded task at a time; preserve invariant IDs INV01–INV23
Never assign a store to an area yourself — membership comes from production (rebuild with scripts/build-data.py)
Never estimate a missing population; never show missing as zero
Add or adjust tests in tests/ for every behaviour change; tests run on the shipped data
Check the browser at 390 and 1280 px in light and dark; use the stub-tile harness when the CDN or tiles are blocked, then confirm on the live site
Bump ?v= in index.html and package.json version for a release; regenerate the manifest on the pushed commit; run npm run verify:live before claiming a release
Report changed files, checks actually run and what remains unverified
